title: 增速六年最低：市场却意外？，药价新政成变数
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What went wrong with the stock and the electronics this morning? Yeah, so I'd say there was a lot of expectation movement down into the print.
segments.zh: 今早股价和电子板块出了什么问题？是的，我认为在财报公布前，市场预期已经有所下调。

segments.en: Some alternative data out there that Q2 sales growth might be somewhat weak.
segments.zh: 一些替代数据显示，第二季度销售增长可能有些疲软。

segments.en: We did get that headline number of US sales growth, only 2.6%.
segments.zh: 我们确实看到了美国销售增长的头条数字，仅为2.6%。

segments.en: There is some regulatory pharmacy issues in there. A lot of these drug prices got pushed down.
segments.zh: 其中存在一些监管方面的药房问题，许多药品价格被压低。

segments.en: Part of the inflation reduction act that's hitting now. So that was about 125 basis point headwind.
segments.zh: 这是《通胀削减法案》的一部分影响，带来了约125个基点的逆风。

segments.en: But with such a high multiple on this stock, you've got to be pinpoint, you've got to hit your numbers each and every quarter.
segments.zh: 但鉴于该股估值倍数较高，你必须精准，每个季度都要达到目标。

segments.en: Even though there's some optics off here, it's just caught people by surprise.
segments.zh: 尽管有些表面现象不佳，但这确实让人感到意外。

segments.en: Is this a hiccup off the back of a change in leadership? What would you call this?
segments.zh: 这是领导层变动后的一个小波折吗？你会怎么形容？

segments.en: I would say that there's probably some of that in here. I think there's a few factors, right?
segments.zh: 我认为其中可能有一些因素，我觉得有几个因素，对吧？

segments.en: You had John Furner take over as the CEO. There's been some domino effect of other leaders leaving Walmart post that.
segments.zh: 约翰·富纳接任CEO后，沃尔玛其他领导层出现了一些连锁离职。

segments.en: Maybe there's a little bit of an operational disruption.
segments.zh: 可能有一点运营上的干扰。

segments.en: You've target doing a lot better. I think maybe that's a little piece of this Amazon getting into Grocery.
segments.zh: 塔吉特表现好很多。我觉得可能有一点是亚马逊进入生鲜领域。

segments.en: And I also say just the lower income consumer stress that's been out there.
segments.zh: 还有低收入消费者的压力一直存在。

segments.en: Nothing totally new, but I think that ate a little more into Walmart this quarter.
segments.zh: 不是全新的事，但我觉得这季度对沃尔玛影响更大一些。

segments.en: How much is this an economic story? And how much is this a Walmart versus competitor story?
segments.zh: 这有多少是经济因素？又有多少是沃尔玛与竞争对手的故事？

segments.en: Is the likes of croggers and target, reduce some of their prices to compete more significantly with Walmart?
segments.zh: 像克罗格和塔吉特这样的公司，是否降低了一些价格，以更显著地与沃尔玛竞争？

segments.en: Yeah, it's a great question. But I think a lot of those price investments from these other grocers, I think that's reactionary to what Walmart's done over the past several years.
segments.zh: 是的，这是个好问题。但我认为其他杂货商的许多价格投入，是对沃尔玛过去几年所做事情的反应。
